 Medium

 Print Movsar Evloev (via Getty) The UFC returns to Etihad Arena on Yas Island this Saturday, October 24, 2026, for UFC 333. The event features two major championship fights. Featherweight champion Alexander Volkanovski puts his title on the line against undefeated contender Movsar Evloev in the main event. Petr Yan also faces Merab Dvalishvili in a bantamweight championship trilogy fight. UFC 333 will begin much earlier than a normal UFC event for fans in the United States. The card will be streamed on Paramount+, with the early prelims starting at 10 a.m. ET. The prelims will follow at 12 p.m. ET, while the main card begins at 2 p.m. ET. Alexander Volkanovski and Movsar Evloev headline UFC 333 in Abu Dhabi Alexander Volkanovski enters the main event with years of championship experience behind him. The 38-year-old Australian is looking to continue his second featherweight title reign against one of the division’s toughest unbeaten contenders. Volkanovski has a professional record of 28-4, while Evloev enters the fight at 20-0. The champion is 5’6” with a 71.5-inch reach. Evloev stands 5’7” and has a 72-inch reach. Both fighters use an orthodox stance. https://x.com/ufc/status/2112865995517985150?s=46 Volkanovski’s last fight was a unanimous-decision win over Diego Lopes. Evloev’s most recent outing ended with a majority-decision victory over Lerone Murphy. Evloev has established himself as one of the UFC’s most persistent wrestlers. He has recorded 49 takedowns inside the Octagon. His wrestling has helped him remain undefeated throughout his UFC career. The Russian has won all 10 of his UFC fights by decision. That record shows how effectively he can control opponents over three or five rounds. His fight against Aljamain Sterling was a strong example of his ability to maintain a demanding grappling battle. The UFC 333 co-main event is also a major attraction. Petr Yan faces Merab Dvalishvili in their bantamweight championship trilogy. The fight could help determine the direction of the division.
